# HAPTIC — HAProxy Template Ingress Controller

> HAPTIC is an open-source Kubernetes controller that renders HAProxy configuration from templates. The Helm chart supports Kubernetes Ingress and Gateway API.

## Released documentation

- [Install with Helm](https://haproxy-haptic.org/docs/latest/getting-started/index.md)
- [Route a Kubernetes Service with Gateway API](https://haproxy-haptic.org/docs/latest/gateway-api/index.md)
- [Migrate an existing ingress controller](https://haproxy-haptic.org/docs/latest/migrating/index.md)
- [Documentation index for the latest release](https://haproxy-haptic.org/docs/latest/llms.txt)
- [Available versions and aliases](https://haproxy-haptic.org/docs/versions.json)

## Development

- [Unreleased documentation index](https://haproxy-haptic.org/docs/dev/llms.txt)
